title: 第5章 剑气漫苍穹震惊京城第6章 青帝的承诺四大宗门两个书院抢人
slug: 六岁皇子麾下竟全是陆地神仙
content_zh:
【九彩灵根：天地灵根的极限，身具九彩灵根，修炼速度是普通的千倍，万倍，修炼过程中更没有任何瓶颈，修行到位，一切都会水到渠成的突破，九彩灵根者，修仙之道更没有极限，甚至拥有超脱天地的潜力！】
月亮已经悬挂在黑夜之中。
银色的光辉笼罩大地。
金碧辉煌的皇宫此刻也归于平静，
元秀殿，陆尘的房间，陆尘看着自己刚刚胖揍陆仁完成任务获得的奖励九彩灵根的详细属性，脸上不由露出了兴奋的神色。
身具九彩灵根，便具有超脱天地的潜力，修炼没有瓶颈。
如此恐怖的加成，自己未来修炼起来，一定会事半功倍。
陆尘紧紧握紧了拳头，
然而，就在这时，陆尘眼前，却再次出现了透明面板。
透明面板之上，一段文字缓缓浮现！
【胖揍了一顿七皇子收个利息，这个时候，你的父皇青帝已经奄奄一息，近乎灯枯油尽，然而，因为你的废物天赋，你这一辈子，没有让青帝多看一眼！】
【发布逆袭任务，你需要想法设法引得青帝的关注，并且让他为你如今的表现感到震撼和骄傲。】
【任务奖励：七窍玲珑心，无上悟性！】
“七窍玲珑心，无上悟性！”
看到眼前透明面板的文字，陆尘眼神闪烁。
从体质，到根骨，再到悟性！
不得不说，这逆袭系统还怪循序渐进嘞。
不过，引得青帝的关注，并让他感到震惊和骄傲。
看来，明天得高调一些了。
就是不知道九彩灵根和无上剑体是否能让青帝感到骄傲。

陆尘若有所思，颇为期待明天的体质灵根悟性测试。
第二天，太阳初升，紫气东来！
一大早，皇宫专门负责皇子修行的雏龙阁便派人来到元秀殿，拉着刚刚苏醒的陆尘前往雏龙阁。
和母亲元妃作别，陆尘跟在身旁的一个白发飘飘的老者旁边。
陆尘陆地神仙境界，能够清楚察觉到旁边老者的境界！
天象境，只在陆地神仙之下！
随便一个小老头就是天象境。
陆尘不禁感慨，这皇宫真的是藏龙卧虎啊。
“十一殿下，老朽枯木道人，乃雏龙阁副阁主，今日负责十一殿下的体质根骨和悟性测试！”
皇宫占地非常广阔。
陆尘跟在老者身边歪七扭八走了将近半个时辰，才看到了一个金碧辉煌的宫殿之中。
而带着陆尘前方的老者向着陆尘拱了拱手开口说道。
“那就麻烦枯木爷爷了！”
陆尘脸上露出了天真无邪的笑容点了点头。
然而，正在这时，陆尘却是心念一动，目光不经意之间看向大殿后方。
陆尘却是从那个方向，感受到了一股恐怖的气息。
这道存在的实力恐怖无比。存在后方，就如同一条真龙盘旋一般，让陆尘汗毛倒立！
这是……
此刻，陆尘眼神深处露出了诧异的神色。
陆尘能够感觉到，这尊恐怖存在，自己陆地神仙境界，和其战斗，也很难战胜。

后方是谁！
陆尘心中突然生出这个想法。
不过，心念一动，陆尘便有了猜测，
在这皇宫之中，实力强于自己这个陆地神仙境，并且在自己测试体质悟性的时候出现。
content_en:
[Nine-colored spiritual roots: The limit of the spiritual roots of heaven and earth. With nine-colored spiritual roots, the cultivation speed is a thousand or ten thousand times faster than ordinary ones. There are no bottlenecks in the cultivation process. If the cultivation is in place, everything will be a natural breakthrough. For those with nine-colored spiritual roots, there are no limits to the way of cultivating immortals, and they even have the potential to transcend heaven and earth! 】
The moon has hung in the dark night.
Silver light enveloped the earth.
The splendid palace also returned to calm at this moment,
In Yuanxiu Hall, Lu Chen's room, Lu Chen couldn't help but look excited when he looked at the detailed attributes of the nine-color spiritual root that he had just beaten up Lu Ren for completing the task.
With nine-color spiritual roots, one has the potential to transcend heaven and earth, and there is no bottleneck in cultivation.
With such a terrifying bonus, I will definitely get twice the result with half the effort when I practice in the future.
Lu Chen clenched his fists tightly,
However, at this moment, a transparent panel appeared in front of Lu Chen again.
On the transparent panel, a piece of text slowly emerged!
[Fat beat up the seventh prince and collected interest. At this time, your father, Qing Emperor, was already dying and almost exhausted. However, because of your useless talent, you never let Qing Emperor take another look in your life! 】
[To release a counterattack mission, you need to find ways to attract Qing Emperor's attention and make him feel shocked and proud of your current performance. 】
[Task reward: Exquisite heart with seven orifices, supreme understanding! 】
"The exquisite heart with seven orifices and supreme understanding!"
Lu Chen's eyes flickered when he saw the text on the transparent panel in front of him.
From the physique, to the bones, to the understanding!
I have to say that this counterattack system is very gradual.
However, it attracted Qing Emperor's attention and made him feel shocked and proud.
It seems that I have to be more high-profile tomorrow.
I just don’t know if the nine-color spiritual root and the supreme sword body can make Qing Emperor proud.
Lu Chen was thoughtful, looking forward to tomorrow's physical and spiritual root comprehension test.
The next day, the sun rises and the purple air comes from the east!
Early in the morning, Chulong Pavilion, which was responsible for the prince's training, sent people to Yuanxiu Hall and took Lu Chen, who had just woken up, to Chulong Pavilion.
Saying goodbye to his mother, Concubine Yuan, Lu Chen followed an old man with flowing white hair beside him.
Lu Chen was in the realm of gods and could clearly detect the realm of the old man next to him!
The celestial realm is only under the land gods!
Any little old man is in the Celestial Realm.
Lu Chen couldn't help but sigh, this palace is really a hidden dragon and a crouching tiger.
"His Royal Highness Eleven, Taoist Taoist Old Dead Wood, is the deputy master of Chulong Pavilion. Today he is in charge of the physical and mental testing of His Highness Eleven!"
The palace covers a very large area.
Lu Chen followed the old man for nearly half an hour and finally saw a splendid palace.
The old man who led Lu Chen in front bowed his hands to Lu Chen and said.
"Then I'll trouble Grandpa Kumu!"
Lu Chen nodded with an innocent smile on his face.
However, at this moment, Lu Chen had a thought in his mind and looked towards the back of the hall inadvertently.
Lu Chen felt a terrifying aura from that direction.
The strength of this existence is terrifying. The presence behind him was like a real dragon circling, making Lu Chen's hair stand on his head!
This is...
At this moment, Lu Chen had a surprised look deep in his eyes.
Lu Chen could feel that it was difficult to defeat this terrifying existence even if he was in the realm of land gods.
Who is behind!
Lu Chen suddenly had this idea in his mind.
However, as soon as his mind moved, Lu Chen had a guess,
In this palace, he is stronger than himself in this terrestrial fairyland, and he appears when he is testing his physical fitness and understanding.
